title: AW27 Women's Season Colour Analysis
summary: Violet leads AW27 womenswear, with tannic bordeaux replacing black and dusty pinks softening the range; waxy ochre is the light.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- At Première Vision, deep violet, plums, dusty pinks, mauves and tinted off-blacks set the tone; violet is "centre stage", and plum and deep red become alternatives to black<sup>[1]</sup>
- Première Vision's colour preview opens with "grayed mid-tones, as if patinated by time", with purples "taking center stage"<sup>[2]</sup>
- Boland expects mustard and chartreuse, creamy white and "sensual black", with bold red, yellow, blue, green and purple<sup>[3]</sup>
- Forecut's AW27 colour forecast: violet, plum and tannic bordeaux replace black over tinted neutrals<sup>[4]</sup>

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** mushroom, tinted black, creamy white.
- **Seasonal:** deep violet, tannic bordeaux, dusty mauve.
- **Accent:** waxy ochre, silicone pink, and one bright: mustard or chartreuse.

sections.heading: By product
sections.body:
- Violet: coats, knits, velvet.
- Bordeaux: leather, tailoring, boots.
- Dusty mauve and silicone pink: knits, satin, accessories.

design_implications: - Lab-dip violet on wool, satin and leather; it shifts strongly between substrates.
commercial_implications: - Replace part of the black buy with tinted black and bordeaux.
